_comment: Drop a file named contracts_finder_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json into the REQUESTS/ folder to trigger the pipeline from any OpenClaw agent or external process. The orchestrator polls this folder and processes the oldest pending file.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this request — used to correlate the RESPONSE_ file

requested_by.description: Which agent or process is triggering the pipeline

mode.description: incremental=since last run, full=last 180 days, date=use since field

since.description: ISO date string — only used when mode=date

dry_run.description: If true, scrape and enrich but do NOT push to HubSpot

skip_apollo.description: If true, skip Apollo contact enrichment (faster, no API cost)

notes.description: Human-readable context for why this run was triggered

example_request.notes: Daily heartbeat trigger from SAD agent

response_format._comment: The orchestrator writes a RESPONSE_{request_id}_{date}.json file to REQUESTS/ when done
